answers.workaround:
Well it can be actually worked around quite easily.

`set_autokill(false)` can be achieved with
```GDScript
tween.finished.connect(tween.stop)
```
`set_autostart(false)` can be achieved with
```GDScript
var tween = create_tween()
tween.stop()
```

In fact this was more or less documented until https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/74258
Users kept running into problems, because the system wasn't really designed for that. While you *can* somewhat reuse Tweens, it's easy to make a mistake if you don't know how it works.
